authority_boundary: DAD owns lifecycle metadata for DAD-managed skill records. Target repos decide whether to check out, update, retire, replace, or locally adapt a skill.

checkout_policy.downstream_mutation_policy: Render checkout artifacts in dry-run mode by default. Never mutate downstream repos, install plugins, or copy full skill bodies without explicit local approval.
